focus: Explain step by step what the training actually taught students to do.

output.title: Decreasing students' stress through time management training: an intervention study

scenes.narration: University students often face high stress levels. This study explored whether a specific time management training program could help undergraduates deal with time-related demands.
scenes.layout_description: A stressed student is in the center, with text floating above a background of scattered clocks.
scenes.visual_prompt: Hand-drawn black ink sketch of a stressed student surrounded by floating clocks and open books, with orange and yellow highlights on the clock faces.

scenes.narration: Researchers evaluated a four-hour time management training intervention. Twenty-three undergraduate students from various faculties attended the program in the middle of the semester.
scenes.layout_description: A table is in the center with students, and text is written on a whiteboard in the background.
scenes.visual_prompt: Sketch of a group of students sitting around a table with a trainer, a whiteboard behind them highlighted with yellow.

scenes.narration: The training aimed to increase perceived control of time and decrease perceived stress, which the study measured using a scale called tension.
scenes.layout_description: A balancing scale is centered, with text labeling the two sides.
scenes.visual_prompt: A vintage balancing scale with a clock on one side and a heavy weight on the other, accented with orange arrows showing the clock rising and the weight falling.

scenes.narration: The training was designed as a homogeneous intervention. It focused on five major parts: prioritizing, goal setting, strategy development, daily planning, and monitoring.
scenes.layout_description: A winding roadmap crosses the screen, with text placed next to the first three flags.
scenes.visual_prompt: A winding roadmap with five distinct stops marked with flags, the path highlighted in yellow ink.

scenes.narration: The first step taught in the training was self-reflection. Students were asked to carefully reflect upon all of their current daily activities.
scenes.layout_description: A student is on the left, with text written on the notebook page they are looking at.
scenes.visual_prompt: A student looking thoughtfully at a blank notebook, holding a pen, with an orange thought bubble above their head.

scenes.narration: During this first phase, students noted down their different activities. This list included both their academic tasks and their various extracurricular activities.
scenes.layout_description: A split list is centered, with text serving as headers for each column.
scenes.visual_prompt: A split list showing a graduation cap icon on one side and a soccer ball on the other, drawn in slightly imperfect black lines.

scenes.narration: Next, they reflected on why these activities were important for their study goals. They asked themselves which activities were truly the most important.
scenes.layout_description: A list is on the right, with a magnifying glass enlarging the text.
scenes.visual_prompt: A magnifying glass focusing on a specific item in a long handwritten list, the glass tinted with a yellow highlight.

scenes.narration: By answering these questions, the students tried to define the most important activities they needed to focus on to succeed in their studies.
scenes.layout_description: A clipboard is angled in the center, with text at the top.
scenes.visual_prompt: A hand drawing a bright orange star next to a top priority item on a clipboard.

scenes.narration: The second step of the training was goal setting. Students learned how to define goals specifically for the important activities they just identified.
scenes.layout_description: A target is on the right, with text written on a banner above it.
scenes.visual_prompt: A target board with an arrow hitting the bullseye, accented with orange circles.

scenes.narration: They were taught to make these goals concrete, challenging, and proximal. This meant figuring out exactly what they wanted to achieve in detail.
scenes.layout_description: Three puzzle pieces are in the center, with text written inside each piece.
scenes.visual_prompt: Three puzzle pieces fitting together to form the shape of a lightbulb, glowing with yellow ink.

scenes.narration: As part of this goal-setting phase, the students also defined clear deadlines for when these specific achievements needed to be fully completed.
scenes.layout_description: A calendar is centered, with text written across the top margin.
scenes.visual_prompt: A calendar page with a specific date circled heavily in orange ink, with a small arrow pointing to it.

scenes.narration: The third major step was strategy development. Students developed a concrete strategy for achieving the goals they had just set for themselves.
scenes.layout_description: A chessboard is at the bottom, with text floating above a chess piece.
scenes.visual_prompt: A chess piece, specifically a knight, moving across a chessboard with a dashed orange line showing its path.

scenes.narration: To build this strategy, they noted down different steps required to reach the goal, set priorities for these steps, and planned how to start.
scenes.layout_description: A staircase ascends from left to right, with text along the steps.
scenes.visual_prompt: A staircase with numbers on each step leading upward, with a yellow glow at the top step.

scenes.narration: They also thought about possible obstacles that might get in their way, and they planned out exactly what to do to overcome them.
scenes.layout_description: A figure is in mid-air, with text written on the hurdle below.
scenes.visual_prompt: A sketch of a stick figure jumping over a hurdle on a running track, the hurdle highlighted in orange.

scenes.narration: In this strategy phase, the trainer emphasized the importance of setting proximal deadlines for each of the individual steps leading to goal achievement.
scenes.layout_description: Stopwatches are arranged in a sequence, with text above the connecting line.
scenes.visual_prompt: A series of small stopwatches linked by a dotted orange line, showing a progression of time.

scenes.narration: The fourth part of the training focused on daily planning. Trainees decided what they wanted to do and developed a concrete schedule.
scenes.layout_description: A planner is centered, with text written on its cover.
scenes.visual_prompt: A daily planner book open to a specific day, with time slots visible and highlighted in yellow.

scenes.narration: They asked themselves which important tasks they should concentrate on the next day, and exactly when and where they were going to complete them.
scenes.layout_description: Icons are in the center, with text written below them.
scenes.visual_prompt: A clock face overlapping with a map pin icon, drawn in simple black ink with orange accents.

scenes.narration: Students also learned to ask themselves how much time should be scheduled for different tasks, and how they could successfully avoid distractions.
scenes.layout_description: A phone and book are side-by-side, with text above the phone.
scenes.visual_prompt: A smartphone with a crossed-out circle over it in orange ink, sitting next to an open textbook.

scenes.narration: The fifth and final part of the training dealt with monitoring. Trainees were instructed to monitor their goal progress and task completion.
scenes.layout_description: A checklist is slightly tilted in the center, with text at the top.
scenes.visual_prompt: A checklist with several boxes checked off in thick yellow ink.

scenes.narration: They learned to monitor their tasks each day to clearly see which ones they had completed and what still had to be done.
scenes.layout_description: Two baskets are side-by-side, with text labeling each basket.
scenes.visual_prompt: Two baskets, one full of checked papers and one empty, with an orange arrow pointing from the full to the empty one.

scenes.narration: To see if this step-by-step training worked, researchers measured the students directly before the training, and then two and four weeks after.
scenes.layout_description: A timeline stretches across the screen, with text above the markers.
scenes.visual_prompt: A horizontal timeline with three distinct points marked with orange circles.

scenes.narration: After the training, the trainees reported a more frequent use of the taught time management strategies than they did before the intervention.
scenes.layout_description: A chart is in the center, with text written along the upward arrow.
scenes.visual_prompt: A simple bar chart showing an upward trend, with a large yellow arrow pointing up and to the right.

scenes.narration: As expected, the students reported significantly less perceived stress two weeks and four weeks after the training, compared to the pretest before training.
scenes.layout_description: A line moves left to right, with text above the smooth section.
scenes.visual_prompt: A jagged, chaotic black line that transitions into a calm, straight line, highlighted in yellow.

scenes.narration: Perceived control of time also increased. While there was only a tendency after two weeks, trainees reported a significant increase four weeks after training.
scenes.layout_description: A student is on the right, with text written on the clock face.
scenes.visual_prompt: A student confidently holding a large clock face like a shield, accented with orange.

scenes.narration: Meanwhile, self-reported demands did not change. This control variable measured things like the amount of work or external duties students were confronted with.
scenes.layout_description: Two frames are side-by-side, with text above the boxes.
scenes.visual_prompt: A stack of heavy boxes remaining exactly the same size in two side-by-side frames, connected by an equals sign.

scenes.narration: Because demands remained unchanged while stress decreased, researchers concluded the positive changes could be attributed to the time management training the students received.
scenes.layout_description: A lightbulb is centered, with text written in the yellow glow.
scenes.visual_prompt: A lightbulb glowing brightly above a stack of books, with yellow ink radiating outward.

scenes.narration: By teaching students to prioritize, set goals, plan, and monitor, time management training might be a beneficial way to improve undergraduate well-being.
scenes.layout_description: A student is centered, with text written in an arc above them.
scenes.visual_prompt: A smiling student wearing a graduation cap, holding a well-organized planner, surrounded by small orange stars.
